bias.en: Downtrend · rebound below the 200-day and Jul 29 low
bias.zh: 下行趋势 · 反弹仍在 200 日均线和 7月29日低点下方

read.en: Micron rose 5.1% on Nov 6 to $690.00, trading $676.00–724.80 on volume about 1.5 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($766.1), 10-day ($846.5), 30-day ($940.0) and 100-day ($959.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($756.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($956.03), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 美光 11月6日上涨 5.1%，收于 $690.00，盘中区间 $676.00–724.80，成交量约为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$766.1）、10 日（$846.5）、30 日（$940.0）和 100 日均线（$959.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$756.7）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$956.03），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The bounce held well above the $650 Nov 5 low, but the $724.80 high faded before the $737.9 Jul 29 low; no level changed. Resistance is $724.8–737.9 (Nov 6 high, Jul 29 low), then $756.7–761.8 (200-day, Nov 5 high) and $782–795 (Nov 4 low and close). Support is $676 (Nov 6 low), then $650–652.2 and $600–605.5. A close above $737.9 would target $757–762; below $650, $605.
